Market today: Tech is still the main driver, but headlines about supply chain strain and potential corrections are a drag. Your concentrated tech/chip book, especially on margin, amplifies both upside and downside.

Your holdings: SOXL is a SELL at -52.58% and SPAL is a TRIM at -39.81%. Both are leveraged ETFs that decay, and your losses are significant. QQQI is also TRIM at -3.58%.

Watch: Keep an eye on the broader market sentiment and any news impacting chip supply or demand.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your leveraged positions and protecting capital.
plays: SOXL: Consider trimming or exiting this leveraged ETF given the -52.58% loss and decay risk.
SPAL: Evaluate reducing exposure to this leveraged ETF due to the -39.81% loss and volatility.
ASML: Watch for a potential entry around 1753.68-1751.93 if the price pulls back into the 1H order block.
